The view stays fixed and level, locked off; the only movement comes from the wind and one car far off. A cold gust keeps tugging at the flattened cardboard, its loose corner lifting and dropping back onto the wet pavement, and the knotted carrier bag rocks on it. Far across the car park, a pair of headlights moves slowly along the perimeter road at walking pace, two soft cones sliding over the wet tarmac.
